name: 🚀 Feature Request

title: "[FEATURE] "

assignees: Amitpwa
---

## 🚀 Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Motivation / Problem Statement

What problem does this feature solve? What use case does it enable?

> "As a [type of user], I want [feature] so that [benefit]."

## 📐 Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working. Be as specific as possible.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds? Why are they not sufficient?

## 🏭 Industrial Use Case

How does this feature apply to industrial automation, edge computing, or SCADA/IIoT use cases?

## 📊 Priority Assessment

| Factor | Your Assessment |
|---|---|
| Impact | (Low / Medium / High) |
| Complexity | (Simple / Moderate / Complex) |
| Urgency | (Nice-to-have / Important / Critical) |

## 🔗 References

Any related issues, PRs, documentation, or external resources:

- Related issue: #
- External standard/protocol: 

## ✔️ Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and the roadmap — this is not already planned or in progress
- [ ] This feature aligns with amitOS's focus on industrial automation and edge computing
- [ ] I have described the use case clearly
